using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Tests
{
    public class ReActEngineTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task GetNextStepAsync_LogsDebugMessage_WhenLlmResponseIsReceived()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var reActEngine = new ReActEngine(null, loggerMock.Object, null);

            // Act
            var llmResponse = new KernelResponse("Test response");
            var result = await reActEngine.GetNextStepAsync(null, null, "Test question", new List<ReActStep>());

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogDebug("Response : {ActionText}", "Test response"), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
